name: xidian-international-hub
description: Prototype GitHub Pages de Xidian International Hub et Xie-Visas

scripts.format: prettier --config .prettierrc.json --ignore-path .prettierignore --write src tests docs public scripts README.md index.html package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .github .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --config .prettierrc.json --ignore-path .prettierignore --check src tests docs public scripts README.md index.html package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .github .prettierrc.json
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
